about.title: About me
about.body: I'm a full-stack developer — Python, Django REST Framework, and React are my day-to-day. I work with service businesses that depend on the phone to make money, and I measure the result with the same public tools you can run yourself: PageSpeed Insights, Chrome UX Report, and Lighthouse. Nothing I say about a site is an opinion — it's a number you can verify on the spot.
